title: What If a Whole Sea Vanished in 50 Years? The Aral Sea Did
subject: Aral Sea

scenes.text: What if a sea vanished in your lifetime? The Aral Sea nearly did.
It was once the fourth largest lake in the world.
Starting in 1960, the rivers feeding it were diverted to irrigate farms, and the water stopped arriving.
Since then it has lost about 88 percent of its surface area and roughly 90 percent of its water volume.
It split into separate bodies of water, and in 2009 its eastern basin nearly disappeared after drought.
Bringing the southern sea back would take over half of the Amu Darya's flow, water that farms in five countries need.
